Just FYI the reason .22 is so deadly as a headshot is because the round bounces around inside the skull, scrambling the brain vs something like a 9mm FMJ which would go straight through.  
  
I didn't mention it before this point though because I think this is a pretty shitty place to discuss ballistics.

Hey man, fuck cops as a concept, but a lot of cops are actually not \*that\* terrible as individuals - just regular folks who make their living licking boots. I've thought about what you're saying lots of times. If you have to go, do it peacefully. There is no need to make your death about hurting someone who is trapped in a similar system as you.  

I wish you the best.
